items.title: 14.4 Simple harmonic motion aur yaksan daairavi harkat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.4 with Figs 14.4-14.7 and Example 14.3 (PDF 25-28).

blocks.text: S.H.M ko achhi tarah samajhne ke liye hum ise uniform circular motion (yaksan raftar se daire mein harkat) se jorte hain, jo hum pehle parh chuke hain. S.H.M ke displacement, velocity, acceleration aur time period ko circular motion se jor kar asaani se samjha ja sakta hai. Jab koi zarra (particle) daire (circle) mein ghoomta hai to us ki projection (saya) daire ke diameter (qutr) par S.H.M karti hai.
Is ke liye radius r wala ek turntable lein jis ke kinare (rim) par ek gend (ball) lagi ho. Roshni ki shua (beam) gend ka saya screen par dalti hai (Fig. 14.4).

Jab turntable constant angular speed ω se ghoomta hai to gend bhi uniform circular motion karti hai. Screen par us ka saya aage peeche jhoolta hai, bilkul spring se bandhe jism ki tarah: yeh simple harmonic motion hai.

blocks.alt: Projector ki roshni oopar se turntable par parti hai jis ke kinare par gend (ball) lagi hai; mura teer gend ki daairavi harkat dikhata hai. Neeche screen par gend ka saya (shadow) aage peeche chalta hai: oscillation of ball's shadow.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.4: Screen par gend ke saye ka jhoolna. Gend yaksan ghoomti turntable se lagi hai (kitab ki Figure 14.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Hisaab se jaiza (quantitative analysis)

Ek zarra P radius x₀ wale daire ke kinare par uniform angular velocity ω se ghoom raha hai. P par us ki linear velocity tangent (daire ko chhoone wali lakeer) ke saath hai: vₚ = rω (yahan r = x₀). Q, P ki projection hai jo diameter par mean position O ke gird jhoolti hai. Jab zarra P par ho to Q, O se x faasle par hota hai.
Instantaneous displacement
Agar P shuru mein A par tha to waqt t mein radius OP, OQ ke saath angle θ = ωt bana leta hai (Fig. 14.5).

blocks.alt: Radius xo ka daira, markaz O, ufqi qutr (diameter) jis ka sira A. Daire par nuqta P angular velocity omega se ghari ki ulti simt ghoomta hai; radius OP, OA ke saath zawiya theta = omega t banata hai. Q qutr par P se giraya amood ka paon hai, aur x = OQ, O se Q ka displacement hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.5: Yaksan angular velocity se daire par chalta nuqta P (kitab ki Figure 14.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Triangle POQ mein:
Equation (14.11) Q ka instantaneous displacement (kisi bhi lamhe ka displacement) deti hai; Q S.H.M kar raha hai.
Instantaneous velocity
Fig. 14.6 mein PR zarre ki velocity vₚ ka horizontal component hai aur yeh diameter AB ke parallel hai. Q sirf horizontal jhoolta hai, is liye Q ki velocity vₚ ka horizontal component hi hai.

blocks.alt: Wahi daira, qutr BA. P par velocity vp tangent ke saath hai. Is ka ufqi hissa v, P se amudi qutr par R tak, BA ke mutawazi, aur barabar teer v, Q par qutr ke saath O ki taraf. vp aur amudi lakeer ka zawiya theta, aur vp aur PR ka zawiya 90 darje minus theta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.6: Nuqta P ki velocity aur us ka ufqi hissa (kitab ki Figure 14.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: vₚ = x₀ω aur cos(90° − θ) = sinθ, is liye:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yeh formula velocity ki miqdar (magnitude) deta hai. Simt (direction) bhi dekhein to jab x musbat (positive) ho aur Q, O ki taraf aa raha ho to velocity manfi (negative) hai: v = −x₀ω sinωt. Isi liye aage Fig. 14.9 (b) ka graph pehle neeche jata hai.
sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, is liye sinθ = √(1 − cos²θ). Ise (14.12) mein rakhein:

blocks.text_alt: v = x₀ω√(1 − x²/x₀²)   (kyun ke cosθ = x/x₀)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Eq. (14.13) ko v = ω√(x₀ − x²) = √((k/m)(x₀² − x₀²)) chhapa hai. Pehle hisse mein x₀ ka square reh gaya hai aur doosre mein x² ki jagah x₀² chhap gaya hai (is tarah to v hamesha 0 aata). Sahi v = ω√(x₀² − x²) = √((k/m)(x₀² − x²)) hai, jo upar likhi hai.
Mean position par x = 0 hai, is liye wahan velocity sab se zyada (maximum) hoti hai:

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Time period, displacement, velocity aur acceleration ke jo formulas projection (saye) ke liye sahi hain, woh daire mein ghoomte zarre par bhi laagu hote hain.
Instantaneous acceleration
P par zarre ka acceleration aₚ daire ke markaz (centre) ki taraf hai (Fig. 14.7). Is ka horizontal component diameter ke saath hai, aur Q ka acceleration yahi horizontal component hai:
Centripetal acceleration aₚ = x₀ω² hai (markaz ki taraf, is liye minus lagta hai) aur cosθ = x/x₀:

blocks.alt: Wahi daira, nuqte A, B aur C. P ka centripetal acceleration ap, PO ke saath markaz ki taraf hai. Is ka ufqi hissa a, Q par qutr BA ke saath O ki taraf amal karta hai. Zawiya theta O aur P par likha hai, aur x faasla OQ hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.7: Nuqta P ka acceleration aur us ka ufqi hissa (kitab ki Figure 14.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Minus ka nishaan batata hai ke acceleration hamesha mean position ki taraf hai.
Zarra uniform angular frequency ω se ghoom raha hai, yani ω constant hai, is liye:

Yahi S.H.M ki shart (condition) hai: acceleration displacement ke directly proportional aur mean position ki taraf. Is se sabit hua ke jab zarra daire ke kinare par ghoomta hai to us ki projection S.H.M karti hai.

blocks.title: Example 14.3
blocks.problem: 0.2 kg mass ek spring se bandha hai jis ka spring constant 10 N m⁻¹ hai. Mass ko equilibrium position se 0.1 m hata kar rest se chhora jata hai. Nikalein: (a) x = 0.05 m par acceleration (b) x = 0.05 m par velocity.
steps: Diya gaya: m = 0.2 kg, k = 10 N m⁻¹, amplitude x₀ = 0.1 m (yahin se chhora gaya). Pehle ω nikalein.
(a) a = −ω²x = −(7.07)² × 0.05 = −50 × 0.05 = −2.5 m s⁻². Minus: acceleration mean position ki taraf hai.
blocks.answer: a ≈ −2.5 m s⁻² aur v ≈ 0.612 m s⁻¹.

blocks.prompt: Amplitude x₀ wale S.H.M mein jab x = x₀/2 ho to speed maximum speed ka kitna hissa hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: v = ω√(x₀² − x₀²/4) = ω√(3x₀²/4) = (√3/2)x₀ω ≈ 0.87 vₘₐₓ. Yani aadhe raste par speed maximum ki taqreeban 87% hai (Example 14.3 mein 0.612/0.707 ≈ 0.87).

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Daire mein uniform ghoomte zarre ki diameter par projection S.H.M karti hai.
x = x₀cosωt; v = x₀ω sinωt (miqdar) = ω√(x₀² − x²); mean position par vₘₐₓ = x₀ω.
a = −ω²x: extreme positions par sab se zyada (x₀ω²), mean position par zero.
